claims: "Arctic Frost" was the codename for an FBI/DOJ investigation.
The "Arctic Frost" investigation was initiated in April 2022.
The "Arctic Frost" investigation was initiated during the Biden administration.

Documents suggest phone records were subpoenaed for numerous GOP lawmakers, including Sens. Lindsey Graham, Josh Hawley, and others.

As of March 2026, fired agents are suing over their termination.
